issue.title: Clean up .gitignore for Android-only Expo project
issue.body:
## Summary

Harden and simplify `.gitignore` for fluent-mobile (Android-only, Expo CNG).

## Problems

- `.env.*` glob matches `.env.example`, which is committed as the env template — risky if the file is ever re-added after untracking
- iOS/Xcode, CocoaPods, and fastlane sections are dead weight from the React Native template (project ships Android only)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `.env.example` remains tracked; `.env` and `.env.local` stay ignored
- [ ] Remove iOS/Xcode/CocoaPods/fastlane boilerplate from `.gitignore`
- [ ] Keep Android build rules, Expo CNG entries (`/android`, `/ios`, `.expo/`), and EAS signing artifacts

## Verification

    git check-ignore -v .env.example   # should NOT match
    git check-ignore -v .env.local     # should match .env.*
